profile.headline: Software engineer @ Sierra Labs
profile.summary:
Full-Stack Engineer | Healthcare Platforms

Built and scaled a multi-tenant healthcare platform used by multiple healthcare organizations and startups to manage patient care, remote monitoring, and clinical workflows.

Designed a monorepo healthcare platform architecture using React 18, NestJS, and TypeScript, enabling rapid onboarding of new healthcare organizations while maintaining strict data isolation and HIPAA compliance.

Solved fragmented patient workflow challenges by building end-to-end systems for patient management, appointment scheduling, care plans, medication tracking, and billing integrations.

Integrated wearable and medical devices (sleep, activity, weight, glucose, heart rate) to enable real-time Remote Patient Monitoring (RPM) and Chronic Care Management (CCM) programs.

Implemented secure, HIPAA-compliant authentication and authorization, role-based access control, and patient data privacy safeguards across the platform.

Built real-time WebSocket communication for patient-clinician messaging, including file sharing and video visit support.

Developed analytics and reporting dashboards to track patient outcomes, biomarker trends, and provider performance, helping care teams make data-driven decisions.
